data.name: Antiutopia
data.detailed_description:
In the early 21st century, political and economic instability pushed nations to the brink. After years of turmoil, the governments of the world signed a historic treaty: merging all nations under a single geopolitical entity known as the One World Order.

For several decades this elite class ruled over the entire world promising an engineered utopia.

And then, unexpectedly, the machine broke. No one knows the exact cause, but the result was the same. The entire world began descending into madness and chaos. Within months the “utopia” dissolved into fractured, desperate states.

As civilization collapsed, two dominant forces seized control of major territories. Neither side seeks peace. Neither side believes the old world can return.

Both claim they can rebuild humanity... in their image.

Welcome to the Antiutopia!

Built by a solo developer using a fully custom 3D engine, Antiutopia strips multiplayer shooters down to their core: movement, aim, and fast decision-making. Matches are quick, intense, and unforgiving. Every kill matters. Every mistake costs your team.

Pure Competitive FPS

  • Fast-paced, skill-based gunplay

  • No loadouts, no perks, no progression systems

  • All players are equal from the moment they spawn

Online Multiplayer

  • Team-based matches with up to 12 players

  • First team to 50 kills wins—or highest score at time limit

  • Friendly fire and suicides cost points, rewarding discipline

Built From Scratch

  • Custom engine, custom networking, no third-party game engines

  • Optimized for low system requirements and fast load times

  • Small install size, quick boots, minimal downtime

Antiutopia isn’t about cosmetics, unlocks, or artificial progression.

It’s about outplaying your opponents! Clean aim, smart movement, and mastering the chaos.

data.short_description: Antiutopia is a fast-paced, skill-based multiplayer FPS set in a fractured sci-fi world. Built from the ground up in a custom engine by a solo developer, it delivers classic arena gun-play, tight matches, and pure competitive action. No progression grind, no gimmicks, just skill.

*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th Gen) or AMD FX-6300 equivalent
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (8th Gen or newer) or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with OpenGL 4.5 support
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
